name: Copper/Gold Ratio: Does It Predict S&P 500 Returns?
description: Tests whether the direction of the copper/gold ratio (rising vs falling over 63 trading days) predicts S&P 500 forward 3-month returns. Copper is cyclical (industrial demand), gold is defensive (safe haven) — a rising ratio signals economic optimism. Uses 63-day ROC of the HG/GC ratio as the regime signal, then measures SPY forward 63-day returns in each regime.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio → S&P 500 Forward 3-Month Returns
# Signal: 63-day ROC of HG/GC ratio (rising = optimism, falling = risk aversion)
# Response: SPY forward 63-day return

# --- Data ---
spy = market_data_source()()
close = spy.c

# Copper (HG) via reference futures + continuation
hg_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.HG)()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)

# Gold (GC) via reference futures + continuation
gc_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.GC)()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
cu_au_ratio = hg_close / gc_close

# 63-day rate of change (3-month momentum of the ratio)
ratio_roc = roc(period=63)(cu_au_ratio)

# Regime: rising (ROC > 0) vs falling (ROC < 0)
is_rising = is_valid(ratio_roc) and ratio_roc > 0
is_falling = is_valid(ratio_roc) and ratio_roc < 0

# Regime label for event markers
regime_label = conditional_select(is_rising, "Rising", is_falling, "Falling", "N/A")

# Detect regime flips
prev_rising = is_rising >> 1
prev_falling = is_falling >> 1
flip_to_rising = is_rising and prev_falling
flip_to_falling = is_falling and prev_rising
is_flip = flip_to_rising or flip_to_falling

# --- Forward Returns (SPY) ---
# forward_returns on price is safe (S46)
fwd_3m = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Regime-filtered forward returns
fwd_rising = where(is_rising, fwd_3m)
fwd_falling = where(is_falling, fwd_3m)

# Hit rate: 1 if positive, 0 if negative, NaN if no data
hit_rising = where(is_rising and is_valid(fwd_3m), 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)
hit_falling = where(is_falling and is_valid(fwd_3m), 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Timestamps ---
ts = index().value

# --- Chart 1: Copper/Gold Ratio with Regime Context ---
# Area fill bands: 1 when rising, 0 when falling (is_band renders shaded regions)
rising_band = 1.0 if is_rising else 0.0
falling_band = 1.0 if is_falling else 0.0

xy_lines(
    title="Copper/Gold Ratio: Rising = Economic Optimism",
    category="Cu/Au Ratio & SPY Returns",
    y_axis_label="Cu/Au Ratio",
    x_axis_label="",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Cu/Au Ratio", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Rising Regime", color=Color.Green, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Falling Regime", color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(cu_au_ratio, rising_band, falling_band))

# --- Chart 2: Punchline — Median 3M SPY Return by Regime ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title="Does the Ratio Direction Predict SPY Returns?",
    category="Cu/Au Ratio & SPY Returns",
    x_axis_label="Regime",
    y_axis_label="Median Fwd 3M Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Rising Cu/Au", color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Falling Cu/Au", color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(fwd_rising, fwd_falling))

# --- Summary Table: Regime Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category="Cu/Au Ratio & SPY Returns",
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="3-Month Forward Return Stats by Regime",
        row_size=5, col_size=2,
        row_headers=["Daily Obs (N)", "Median Return", "Hit Rate (% Positive)", "Best", "Worst"],
        col_headers=["Rising Cu/Au", "Falling Cu/Au"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(fwd_rising, fwd_falling, hit_rising, hit_falling, fwd_rising, fwd_falling, fwd_rising, fwd_falling, fwd_rising, fwd_falling)

# --- Event Markers: Regime Flips ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Cu/Au Regime Flip",
        icon=Icon.ShuffleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="New Regime", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Ratio ROC (63d)", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Cu/Au Ratio", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="SPY Close", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, ratio_roc, cu_au_ratio, close, is_flip)
